title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 to a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF Under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), Commodity-Based Trust Shares
summary: On 27 December 2021, the Federal Register published an SEC notice that Cboe BZX Exchange had filed Amendment No. 1 (File No. SR-CboeBZX-2021-051) to its proposed rule change to list and trade shares of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), the exchange's Commodity-Based Trust Shares listing standard. The trust's sponsor is 21Shares US LLC. BZX originally filed the proposal on 20 July 2021, and the Commission had already instituted proceedings on 2 November 2021 to decide whether to approve or disapprove it. Filed 9 December 2021, Amendment No. 1 replaced and superseded the original filing in its entirety, clarifying points and adding detail; publication opened public comment on the amended proposal and does not resolve how the SEC will ultimately act.
why_it_matters: This notice reopened public comment on a revised filing for a proposed crypto exchange-traded product listing -- formally replacing and superseding the original filing, though the exchange described the changes only as clarifying points and adding detail -- filed while the SEC's formal proceeding on the original proposal was already underway, illustrating how an exchange can amend a pending 19b-4 filing mid-review. It does not itself approve or disapprove anything, and does not address how the SEC ultimately acted on this proposal.
